# FIGURE 2.B: REGRESSION OF COLIBACTIN MUTAGENESIS VERSUS AGE:

```{r}
library(ggh4x)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(emmeans)
library(ggplot2)
library(lmerTest)
library(broom.mixed)
```

```{r}
## paediatric samples
crypt_signature_attributions<-read.csv('../Data/crypt_signature_attributions.csv')
crypt_metadata<-read.csv('../Data/biopsy_metadata.csv')

## adult samples
lee_six_2019_nature<-read.csv('../Data/lee_six_nature_2019_sbs_id_attribution.csv')%>%
  mutate(site=ifelse(site=='Transverse','Right',site))%>%
  filter(site!='Ileum')
```
## a : perform regrssion of age versus colibactin mutational burden
```{r}
# construct a dataframe for regression models
colibactin_burdens_regressions_df<-left_join(crypt_metadata,crypt_signature_attributions,by=c('biopsy','patient'))%>%
  ungroup()%>%
  filter(location %in% c('Sigmoid','Ascending','Transverse'))%>% # exclude terminal ileum / caecum / rectum
  filter(SBS88>0 & ID18>0)%>%
  dplyr::select(patient,biopsy,site,sex,SBS88,ID18,age)

# adult crypt burdens
adult_colibactin_burdens_regression_df<-lee_six_2019_nature%>%
  mutate(biopsy=paste(patient,site,sep='_'))%>%
  dplyr::select(patient, biopsy,site,sex,SBS88, ID18, age)%>%
  filter(SBS88>0 & ID18>0)

colibactin_burdens_regressions_df<-rbind(colibactin_burdens_regressions_df,adult_colibactin_burdens_regression_df)
# run mixed effects regression for SBS88 and ID18

models_df <- colibactin_burdens_regressions_df %>%
  pivot_longer(c(SBS88, ID18), names_to = "mut_type", values_to = "burden") %>%
  nest(data = -mut_type) %>%
  mutate(
    model = map(data, ~ lmer(burden ~ age * site + (1 | patient), data = .x)),

    # slope within each site, with CI + p-value vs 0
    slopes = map(model, ~ emtrends(.x, ~ site, var = "age") %>%
                   summary(infer = c(TRUE, TRUE)) %>%
                   as_tibble()),)

models_output<-models_df %>% select(mut_type, slopes)%>% 
  unnest(slopes)%>%
  mutate(p.adj=p.adjust(p.value,'fdr'))
```

print the output from modelling:
```{r}
print(models_output)
```

## b : plot regrssion of age versus colibactin mutational burden
```{r}
## plot association of colibactin mutagenesis versus time
# construct a dataframe for plotting:

colibactin_burdens_plot_df<-colibactin_burdens_regressions_df%>%
  pivot_longer(cols=c('SBS88','ID18'),names_to='mut_type',values_to='counts')%>%
  mutate(site=ifelse(site=='Transverse','Right',site))%>%
  filter(site!='Ileum')%>%
  group_by(patient, site, mut_type)%>%
  summarise(median=median(counts,na.rm=T),
            lower=quantile(counts,0.25,na.rm=T),
            upper=quantile(counts,0.75,na.rm=T),
            age=median(age))%>%
  mutate(mut_type=factor(mut_type,levels=c('SBS88','ID18')))
  
make_pred <- function(m, d, n = 100) {
  rng  <- d %>% group_by(site) %>% summarise(lo = min(age), hi = max(age), .groups = "drop")
  ages <- seq(min(d$age), max(d$age), length.out = n)

  emmeans(m, ~ age | site, at = list(age = ages)) %>%
    as_tibble() %>%
    left_join(rng, by = "site") %>%
    filter(age >= lo, age <= hi) %>%          # don't extrapolate past each site's data
    transmute(site, age, fit = emmean, lwr = lower.CL, upr = upper.CL)
}

regression_df_expanded <- models_df %>%
  transmute(mut_type, pred = map2(model, data, make_pred)) %>%
  unnest(pred)%>%
  mutate(mut_type=factor(mut_type,levels=c('SBS88','ID18')))
labels_df <- models_output %>%
  transmute(
    mut_type, site,
    label = paste0(round(age.trend,1),'mutations/year [95%CI ',round(lower.CL,1),', ',round(upper.CL,1),']')
  )%>%
  mutate(mut_type=factor(mut_type,levels=c('SBS88','ID18')))
```

## b : plot the association of age and colibactin mutation burden
```{r}
svglite::svglite('../Figure2/colibactin_age_burdens.svg',width=12,height=7)
ggplot(data = colibactin_burdens_plot_df, aes(x = age, y = median)) +
  geom_ribbon(data = regression_df_expanded,
            aes(x = age, ymin = lwr, ymax = upr),fill = 'grey60',
            inherit.aes = FALSE, alpha = 0.5, show.legend = FALSE) +
geom_line(data = regression_df_expanded,
          aes(x = age, y = fit,  linetype = "Mutation Burden ~ Age"),
          inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = 0.8,colour = 'grey20') +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper),size = 1, width = 0, colour = "grey60",alpha=1) +
  geom_point(fill = 'maroon3', shape=21,col='grey10',size = 2) +
  scale_x_continuous() +
  facet_grid(mut_type~site, scales = "free", 
             switch='y',
             label = labeller(mut_type = as_labeller(c(SBS88 = "SBS 88 Burden", ID18 = "ID 18 Burden")),
                              site = as_labeller(c(Left = "Colon Left Side", Right = "Colon Right Side")))) +
  facetted_pos_scales(y = list(mut_type == "SBS88" ~ scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 2250)), 
                               TRUE ~ scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 400)))) +
  theme_classic() +
  
  scale_linetype_manual(
    values = c("Mutation Burden ~ Age" = "dashed"),
    name = NULL
  ) +
  scale_alpha_manual(
    values = c("Mutation Burden ~ Age" = 0.5),
    name = NULL
  ) +
  
  labs(
    x = "Donor Age at Biopsy [years]",
    y = "",
    fill = "Biopsy Site"
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", colour = "grey20"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    strip.placement.y='outside',
    strip.placement.x='inside',
    strip.text = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold")
  )
dev.off()
```
